# ufbx

Vendored ufbx v0.20.1, commit `13b5df8e89eff0ce898f7c37fa0716e3bc186573`.
Source: https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/tree/13b5df8e89eff0ce898f7c37fa0716e3bc186573

`ufbx.c`, `ufbx.h`, and `LICENSE` are unmodified upstream files.
Medicon uses the MIT option in the upstream dual license.
Compiled as a separate C library; no loading/parsing runs on native render callbacks.
